args.title: Bellwether Freight Pricing Summary (2026) — Main Post + Companion
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/freight and its companion piece (https://insights.bellwether.example/freight/companion):

- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices rather than longer-term averages.
- Companion piece finding: shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.

Sources accessed: main blog post; companion piece loaded via free registration using tomas.whitfield@northwind.example (no password required).
